```{r}

library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

kpif_raw <- read_excel("KPIF.xlsx")

head(kpif_raw)


x <- read_excel("KPIF.xlsx", col_names = FALSE)

kpif <- tibble(
  date = unlist(x[3, ]),
  kpif = as.numeric(unlist(x[4, ]))
) |>
  drop_na()

library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(zoo)




kpif_raw <- read_excel("KPIF.xlsx", col_names = FALSE)

kpif <- tibble(
  date = as.yearmon(unlist(kpif_raw[3, ]), "%YM%m"),
  kpif = as.numeric(unlist(kpif_raw[4, ]))
) |>
  drop_na()






eur_raw <- read_excel(
  "/Users/joelsoderman/Downloads/DETALJERAT RESULTAT_2026-05-18_10_35.xlsx",
  col_names = FALSE
)

eursek <- eur_raw |>
  slice(6:n()) |>
  transmute(
    date = as.yearmon(paste(...1), "%Y %B"),
    eursek = as.numeric(...2)
  ) |>
  drop_na()






energy_raw <- read_excel(
  "/Users/joelsoderman/Downloads/0000083S_20260518-103708.xlsx",
  col_names = FALSE
)

energy <- tibble(
  date = as.character(unlist(energy_raw[3, -1])),
  energy = as.numeric(unlist(energy_raw[4, -1]))
) |>
  filter(!is.na(date), !is.na(energy)) |>
  mutate(date = as.yearmon(date, "%YM%m"))







df <- kpif |>
  inner_join(eursek, by = "date") |>
  inner_join(energy, by = "date") |>
  arrange(date)




glimpse(df)
head(df)
tail(df)
```
